text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding out what could go wrong in a project. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are actions you take if a risk actually occurs. Finally, you should keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. By following these steps, you can protect your project and make better decisions.
